title: Pink Fairy Halloween Costume
intro: If you want a costume that photographs like a dream, go fairy. Glitter wings with a matching wand, a flower crown headband, a deep pink sparkle tulle skirt, a sequin tank and glitter ballet flats come together in about five minutes and survive a whole night of dancing. Nothing pinches, nothing needs pinning and nothing falls off when you sit down. The sequin tank and the glitter flats go straight back into your going out rotation, and the wings make a very persuasive argument for a pink holiday tree.
